prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1083; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. Initial evaluation revealed pain, swelling, and limited range of motion of the left wrist. Imaging confirmed a distal radius fracture with mild dorsal angulation, and the fracture was managed with closed reduction and immobilization in a short arm cast. Follow-up imaging demonstrated satisfactory alignment and early callus formation.

Over the course of 21 visits, the patient completed serial radiographic monitoring, cast management, and progressive removal of immobilization. Physical therapy was initiated once healing was adequate, focusing on restoring range of motion, grip strength, and forearm rotation. Pain was managed with a combination of over-the-counter analgesics and, during the early phase, a short course of prescription medication. Ergonomic and activity modifications were reviewed with the patient.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient demonstrated near-full wrist motion and improving grip strength, with residual stiffness noted at end range. Ongoing home exercises and occupational therapy recommendations were provided. Continued monitoring is advised to ensure complete functional recovery.
